title: Login loop and ride/payment failures lock users out of Uber app

steps: Reproduce: trigger session expiration in the gpodder.net authentication flow
Diagnose: empty username/password slips through and fails server-side, leaving the user in a confusing loop
Propose fix: trim username, reject empty credentials client-side with a visible error before calling service.login()
Validate: git apply --check on real source tree

title: App is a heavy battery drainer when running in background
affected_component: Background services / persistent notification / wake-lock usage

steps: Profile: persistent foreground notification rebuilt frequently while playback is paused
Identify hot path: PlaybackServiceNotificationBuilder.build() leaves sound/vibration unset, allowing each rebuild to wake the device
Optimize: explicitly suppress sound and vibration on the foreground notification (it should never alert)
Benchmark: measure background CPU and wake-up frequency before/after
Add regression test: assert notification.setSound(null) / setVibrate(null) on rebuild

navigator_output.selection_method: ripgrep over cloned repo for affected_component keywords (Navigator real)

editor_output.proposed_change: In PlaybackServiceNotificationBuilder.build(), explicitly set notification.setSound(null) and setVibrate(null) so the persistent foreground notification never re-alerts the device, reducing wake-ups and battery drain.
